description: This file contains source code for the 'validator' module within torch.fx.experimental, implementing translation validation for Dynamo guards using Z3 SMT solver, including classes and functions for symbolic expression translation, guard validation, and bisection of validation errors.

classes.name: TranslationValidator
classes.description: Class for validating translation guards by checking the consistency between source and target guard expressions using Z3 SMT solver.

classes.name: SympyToZ3
classes.description: Class for translating SymPy expressions into Z3 expressions, used within guard validation.

methods.name: z3str
methods.description: Converts a Z3 expression into a string representation with simplifications and specific formatting rules.

methods.name: z3op
methods.description: Wraps a Python operator to operate on Z3 expressions, lifting arguments into Z3 domain.

methods.name: PopulateValidator
methods.description: Class that walks through an FX graph, translating nodes into Z3 expressions and populating a validator with guard assertions.

methods.name: SympyToZ3
methods.description: Class that translates SymPy expressions into Z3 expressions, supporting various mathematical operations.

methods.name: translation_validation_enabled
methods.description: Function that checks if translation validation is enabled and Z3 is installed.

methods.name: translation_validation_timeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout for translation validation.

methods.name: ValidationException
methods.description: Exception raised when translation validation fails, including detailed model and expression info.

methods.name: BisectValidationException
methods.description: Exception for errors encountered during bisection of validation failures.
